name: Pilot Hammerfoot
summary: Pilot Hammerfoot is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed near the mountain passes connecting Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Worried for a fellow pilot lost in the hills, he seeks willing adventurers to search for his friend. His presence highlights the dangers faced by dwarves along the high alpine ridges.

sections.title: Eyes in the Mountains
sections.body: Ironforge's siege engines are the pride of its Siege Brigade, but driving them across harsh mountainous terrain carries extreme risk. Stationed at the North Gate Outpost overlooking the border between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan, Pilot Hammerfoot guards the pilots' engines and watches the mountain passes. When a pilot goes missing, finding him quickly becomes a priority, especially with savage beasts prowling the nearby hills.

sections.title: Avenging a Comrade
sections.body: Hammerfoot was close friends with Pilot Mori Hildelve, a fellow siege engine pilot who busted his engine on a steep hill while the two searched for a rare ore, then went on alone on foot. Upon learning that Hildelve was mauled to death by Mangeclaw, a huge ice claw bear, Hammerfoot's mission shifts from routine border watch to personal vengeance, demanding retribution against the beast responsible for his friend's death.

faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot is a dwarven siege engine pilot serving Ironforge. He is stationed at North Gate Outpost along the pass connecting Dun Morogh to Loch Modan, watching over the region's borders and his fellow pilots.

faq.q: Where can Pilot Hammerfoot be found?
faq.answer: He is located at North Gate Outpost, situated along the mountain highway guarding the tunnel pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

faq.q: What happened to Hammerfoot's partner, Pilot Hildelve?
faq.answer: Pilot Mori Hildelve broke his siege engine on a steep hill while searching for rare ore and continued on foot. Hammerfoot has not heard from him and asks travelers to investigate.

faq.q: Why is Hammerfoot worried about his partner?
faq.answer: Hammerfoot and Mori Hildelve are close friends and fellow Siege Brigade pilots. Hildelve has gone missing in dangerous mountain terrain, and Hammerfoot needs someone to discover what happened.

angles.text: Hammerfoot embodies the fierce camaraderie of the Ironforge mountaineers, refusing to let a fallen brother's murder go unanswered.
Aiding Hammerfoot secures vital reconnaissance outposts along the primary highway linking Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.
